episode_summary: Case Blackwell's Wednesday edition of Barely Informed News features the debut of a Hyper Train detour into crypto-universe lore, a long Munch vs Crum debate segment reacting to a community thread calling for Crum's violence, and an extended Jill of the Jungle retro-gameplay finale. The episode blends real news (Pentagon testosterone screening, Epstein Transparency Act, donkey-shooting cop) with the show's recurring absurd characters and feuds.

segments.title: Pre-show / Pepito Intro & Skeleton Bit
segments.notes: Pepito cold open, studio skeleton props, ad-hoc Filipino Christmas tree bit with Kendall, plug for upcoming Chicago Sketchfest date (Oct 2) and a 'slightly larger project' announcement.

segments.title: News Time & Hyper Train Arrival
segments.notes: Case kicks off the actual news segment. Hyper Train interrupts with Piss Fruit Ninja promo, vaudeville beat request, and refuses to take a politics stance (he's 'in piss').

segments.title: Vaudeville Type Beat / Crypto Universe
segments.notes: Hyper Train runs his raps about Panther girlfriend, bags of piss, Bane/Tom Hardy, Woody-from-crypto-universe lore, Sam Bankman Friend (SBF), and Hellcoin. Case repeatedly calls it a crypto scam.

segments.title: News Story 1: Pentagon Testosterone Screening
segments.notes: Case reads Reuters story on mandatory testosterone screening for service members 30+. Discussion of male pattern baldness trade-off, women's menstrual tracking, and Pete Hegseth. Reporter credit: Christy Santhosh.

segments.title: News Story 2: Epstein Transparency Act II
segments.notes: Rep. Massey's floor speech calling for arrests. Crum barges in claiming he's not in the Epstein files; brings up 'getting his penis punched on Monday.' Case roasts Crum, references a Discord thread about Crum, and tells Crum to leave.

segments.title: News Story 3: Robot Vacuum Spying / Petting Zoo Donkey Shooting
segments.notes: Taiwanese robot-vac divorce story, then a Polk County cop shooting a petting-zoo donkey while searching for a missing girl. Donkey bites tangent. Dog-jumps-56-people record bit.

segments.title: News Story 4: Boob Proportions Study
segments.notes: 'Skynce' persona reads Brazilian Journal of Plastic Surgery study on ideal 50/50 breast ratio. Includes 'all boobs is good' landing and announcer Christian gets a brief cameo. Pepperoni-pizza tangent.

segments.title: Munch vs Crum Debate: Penis Punch Discord Thread
segments.notes: Munch and Crum introduce themselves. Read chat/Discord thread compiled by Case listing reasons Crum should get his penis punched Monday — bald, bitch, hand-game hype, an OnlyFans threat, best-boob club vs Crum's wife. Crum vows he has trained and has 'super strength in spits.'

segments.title: Jill of the Jungle Gameplay
segments.notes: Almost the entire second hour is live DOS-game playthrough of Epic Mega Games' Jill of the Jungle trilogy. Recurring Gooters chicken-wing plugs and mom-Old-English tangents. Mom claims she 'used to look like Jill.' Includes in-game UPI 'epic exodus' lore scrolling.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Host. Performs every on-air voice/character. Anchors every news story and the gameplay finale.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Standard cold-open: 'I'm Pepito, I'm the dog that produces the show, and now it is live, and I'm a dog.'

characters.name: Kendall
characters.notes: Studio guest referenced throughout — asked to talk to skeletons, fed lines to Filipino Christmas tree, and is one half of the 'Kendall vs Christian' debate whose prompt gets eaten by the penis-punch thread.

characters.name: Hyper Train
characters.notes: Recurring hype-train persona. Does Piss Fruit Ninja promo, vaudeo beat requests, Panther girlfriend rap, defends his 'crypto universe' origin, and tries to push the 'Piss Fruit Ninja' video-game pitch.

characters.name: Jeff Hooper
characters.notes: Chat/news reader, gets credited with the 'how come they drew this one kind of bad' line and trades jabs with Hyper Train.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: Defends himself against Epstein-files slander, claims 'getting penis punched on Monday,' hosts Best Boob Club at his house (not a member), declares 'super strength in spits,' claims to keep carrots in his glove box for donkeys.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: Promises violence toward Crum on Monday; reads the Discord 'reasons Crum should get his penis punched' list; reveals Crum hosts (but is excluded from) the Best Boob Club.

characters.name: Christian
characters.notes: Announcer/lab-assistant cameo; subject of the Christian vs Kendall debate prompt; sent to pick up food; wins that debate with a big margin per Case.

characters.name: Skynce / Skyentist
characters.notes: Voice-changer persona used for the boob-proportions segment. Has 'most of the boobs in training data' and refuses to pick a favorite, landing on 'all boobs is good.'

storylines.beat: Crum barges into the Epstein-files segment defending himself; escalates into the formal debate where Munch reads a community-thread list justifying violence toward Crum. Crum declares he is 'getting my penis punched on Monday' and has been training, claiming 'super strength in spits.'
Munch references a Discord thread 'telling Crum why he sucks' and hands the penis-punch thread off to be addressed during the Munch vs Crum debate proper.
Best Boob Club lore expansion: Crum hosts the club at his house but is told 'you're just the host, you're not a member'; Munch presses him with a candle prompt.
Crum offers a closing threat: 'My penis can handle a lot... good luck to that gorilla's fist'; promises Monday confrontation.

Hyper Train claims he was born in hell but raised in the crypto universe, where SpongeBob/Squidward/Patrick exist, sand is non-fungible, and Sam Bankman Fried is 'Sam Bankman Friend.' Case repeatedly calls it a crypto scam.

storylines.storyline: Hyper Train Piss Fruit Ninja pitch
storylines.beat: Hyper Train pitches a AAA game called 'Piss Fruit Ninja' after Case spoils it on air, then fires all developers. Re-emerges during the Epstein segment asking 'does crumb count?'
Today's debate prompt ('Christian vs Kendall') is hijacked by the Crum penis-punch thread; chat vote ends in a 'pretty big margin' win for Christian.
Case streams Epic Mega Games' DOS trilogy Jill of the Jungle live for the back half of the show, ending on a save state with in-game scrolling 'epic exodus' lore about Mario and D. Newcomb retiring.

lore_notes.fact: Standard opening line: 'I'm Pepito, I'm the dog that produces the show, and now it is live, and I'm a dog.'
Claims Piss Fruit Ninja was a AAA studio-locked game he was developing; blames Case for spoiling it on air.
Hails from the 'crypto universe,' where Patrick is 'the Starfish guy,' sand is non-fungible, and Sam Bankman Fried is 'Sam Bankman Friend.' He was 'born in hell but raised in the crypto universe.'
Has a girlfriend nicknamed 'Panther' and says he keeps the relationship open — 'I don't believe in ownership like that.'

Vows publicly on stream that 'I will be getting my penis punched on Monday,' and later in the debate claims he has trained for it and possesses 'super strength for some reason in spits,' demonstrated by crushing an electric toothbrush to dust.
Hosts the Best Boob Club at his house 'because their wives get mad if they do it,' but is told 'you're just the host, you're not a member' — his own wife's breasts are repeatedly rejected.
Keeps carrots in his glove box 'in case I encounter a donkey' and changes them every two or three days.
Insists he is not in the Epstein files despite one search hit; explains it as accidentally emailing 'Jeffrey Epstein' instead of YouTuber 'Jabri Epstein' ~300 times due to Google auto-complete.
Mocks his own 'hand game' as 'grossly overhyped' by himself, but floats launching an OnlyFans to prove it ('not because it's sexual… an exhibition of skill').

Reads community-supplied 'reasons you deserve to get your dick punched' list: you're bald, you're a bitch, it will make Munch envious he's not getting the same treatment (joke from 'Yojimbo'), hand game overhyped.
Mentions an upcoming Chicago Sketchfest date 'October 2nd' and teases 'a slightly larger project' announcement with the sketch group.
Credited reporter on the Pentagon story: 'Reporting for this was done by Christy Santhosh.'
When called out for slander, Case invokes the 'new thing in the news is slander streamers relentlessly all day' line and references 'Cutie Cinderella' being over-mentioned on CNN.
Skynce persona's core shtick: 'all the boobs are in my training data' but they are not allowed to discuss them; concludes 'all boobs is good' as the scientific finding.
This episode's intended prompt was Christian vs Kendall, but was overtaken by the Crum-penis-punch thread; chat vote ended in a 'pretty big margin' win for Christian.

Case's mom bit: hit her head bumper-carring with 'Pastor Joe' at a local fair and now occasionally speaks in Old English by adding extra vowels; plugs Gooters 'dino fries' throughout the gameplay segment.
